Addressing the INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge accused the BJP-led governments at the Centre and in several states of coming to power through electoral theft. Calling for opposition unity, Kharge vowed to fight to remove Prime Minister Narendra Modi, protect the Constitution and strengthen democracy.
